title: Little Li's Recipe
synopsis: Did you ever want to make authentic Chinese food but had trouble reading Chinese recipes? In this lesson we learn words and classifiers common to recipes, and start our journey on becoming Chinese food experts!

fullText.simplified:
小李菜谱：西红柿炒鸡蛋

菜谱简介：
西红柿炒鸡蛋是一道普通的家常菜。它不但做法简单，而且营养丰富，所以非常受到大家的喜爱。

材料：
鸡蛋3个，西红柿2个，葱1根，盐5克，食用油15毫升，味精3克。

做法：
1、西红柿洗干净后用开水烫两分钟后去皮，切片。
2、鸡蛋打入碗中，加入少许盐和味精，打散成蛋液。
3、葱洗干净后切末。
4、锅内倒油烧至微热，倒入蛋液，先别翻动，等蛋液凝固一些后再翻动。
5、倒入西红柿，炒至鸡蛋和西红柿变软后放入少许盐和味精，最后倒入葱末即可。

小贴士：
1、鸡蛋里加一点水，炒出来的鸡蛋更嫩。
2、炒西红柿的时候可以加点糖，更香更好吃。
fullText.traditional:
小李菜譜：西紅柿炒雞蛋

菜譜簡介：
西紅柿炒雞蛋是一道普通的家常菜。它不但做法簡單，而且營養豐富，所以非常受到大家的喜愛。

材料：
雞蛋3個，西紅柿2個，蔥1根，鹽5克，食用油15毫升，味精3克。

做法：
1、西紅柿洗乾淨後用開水燙兩分鐘後去皮，切片。
2、雞蛋打入碗中，加入少許鹽和味精，打散成蛋液。
3、蔥洗乾淨後切末。
4、鍋內倒油燒至微熱，倒入蛋液，先別翻動，等蛋液凝固一些後再翻動。
5、倒入西紅柿，炒至雞蛋和西紅柿變軟後放入少許鹽和味精，最後倒入蔥末即可。

小貼士：
1、雞蛋裡加一點水，炒出來的雞蛋更嫩。
2、炒西紅柿的時候可以加點糖，更香更好吃。

raw.synopsis: Did you ever want to make authentic Chinese food but had trouble reading Chinese recipes? In this lesson we learn words and classifiers common to recipes, and start our journey on becoming Chinese food experts!
sentence_translations: Little Li's recipe: Stir-fried tomato eggs
Stir-fried tomato eggs is a common household dish.
It's not only easy to make, but also rich in nutrition, which makes it loved by everyone.
3 eggs, 2 tomatoes, 1 scallion, 5 grams of salt, 15 ml cooking oil, 3 grams of MSG.
1. After washing the tomatoes clean, scald them using hot water for two minutes, then remove the skin and slice them.
2. Crack the eggs into a bowl, add some salt and MSG, then whisk until they become liquid.
3. Wash the scallions and cut off the tips.
4. Put some oil in a pan and heat until mildly warm. Pour in the beaten eggs.
Don't stir at first; wait until the eggs solidify a bit and then stir.
5. Add the tomatoes and stir until the eggs and tomatoes become soft, then add a bit of salt and MSG.
Finally add the scallion tips and that's it.
1. Add a bit of water to the eggs, and the stir-fried eggs will come out even more tender.
2. You can add a little sugar when stir-frying the tomatoes, and they will be even more fragrant and delicious.
